description: Discover public ChatRook video rooms directly in ChatGPT. Search by room title or slug, check recent participant counts, and get a link to open a room on ChatRook. Check a specific public room before opening it. No login is needed for public discovery. Joining happens on ChatRook and may require signing in or meeting access checks. Room names are user-generated, and recent presence does not guarantee a live conversation. This connector does not read private rooms, messages or recordings, create meetings, contact anyone, start calls, or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Find three public rooms and show me their details and join links.
